description: Timetable for a date range, per day: lessons, tests and other appointments with time, lesson hour, subject, room, teachers, type (e.g. ROOSTERTOETS, EXAMEN, OUDERAVOND), lesson notes, changes and cancellations (wijziging, uitgevallen=true, meldingen with real warnings only; the routine 'Inschrijving in orde.' notice is dropped), attachments, and holidays. Every day has items (empty array on a free day). Defaults to today plus 6 days; at most 42 days.

from.description: First date of the range. Defaults to today.

leerlingId.description: Numeric leerling id. Required when more than one child is linked.
